snippet.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows - Official Claws of Awaji DLC Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Claws of Awaji DLC Launch Trailer for Assassin's Creed Shadows, a DLC to the hit action-adventure open-world game developed by Ubisoft. Players will join Naoe and Yasuke on a journey to the cryptic island of Awaji in search of lost treasure. Face off against the Ippa clan to unlock new skills, gear, outfits, and more. The Claws of Awaji DLC for Assassin's Creed is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
